title: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
paperTitle: 2025年6月大学英语四级真题（第3套）
prompt: 近年来,中国越来越多的城市着力打造"15分钟便民生活圈(convenient living circles)"。社区居民步行15分钟就能享受到日常所需的公共服务。生活圈内建有便利店、公园、健身场地、图书馆、学校、社区食堂、诊所等。生活圈的建立能够为居民提供更加便利、舒适、友好、愉悦的生活环境,更好地满足城市居民多元化的日常生活服务需求,提升居民的生活品质和幸福感。
reference: In recent years, an increasing number of Chinese cities have been striving to build "15-minute convenient living circles". Within such a circle, community residents can have access to the public services they need in daily life within just a 15-minute walk. There are facilities such as convenience stores, parks, fitness areas, libraries, schools, community canteens and clinics. The establishment of these living circles can provide residents with a more convenient, comfortable, friendly and pleasant living environment, thus better meeting the diverse daily-life service needs of urban residents and improving their quality of life and sense of happiness.
